_readme: PRICES: €100/month for the duo comes from the cost document. The starter
and single-month figures still need setting — they carry PRICE TBD markers.
EU consumer law note: the commitment length, the total price and how to
cancel must be stated clearly BEFORE the customer pays. The eu_terms block
renders that disclosure here; it must also appear at checkout.
Have this reviewed by a lawyer before launch — see COPY-REVIEW.md.
MEMBER CONTENT WORDING: describe it as a fuller, more detailed briefing.
Do NOT describe it as personalised — we are not promising individual
assessment, and it would be a claim we cannot stand behind.

eu_terms.title: What you are agreeing to, in plain words
items: The membership renews every 28 days at the price shown above until you cancel it.
It runs for a minimum of three deliveries. That is the shortest course that can honestly do anything, and it is why we ask for it.
After those three deliveries you can pause, reschedule or cancel at any time, from your account, in two clicks — no phone call and no form. See [your account](/account/).
You have the statutory 14-day right of withdrawal on your first order under EU consumer law, in addition to the above.
We will email you before every renewal, with enough notice to skip it.
The commitment, the price and the cancellation terms are shown again at checkout before you pay.

sections.heading: Because the alternative is taking your money for something we know is too short.
paragraphs: We could sell single bottles. It would be easier, and plenty of people would buy one, try it for five weeks, decide it did nothing and move on. That is a good month for a supplement company and a bad outcome for a woman losing her hair.

The three-month minimum is us refusing to build a business on that. It is also, we know, a bigger ask than clicking 'add to basket' — which is why the starter bundle exists for anyone who wants the full course without a recurring payment, why the timeline page is written to talk you out of expecting miracles, and why [cancelling takes two clicks](/account/).
sections.statement: We would rather be the brand that asked for more and then told you the truth about how long it takes.

sections.heading: The long version, for the people actually doing this.
paragraphs: The Learn hub is open to everyone and always will be. It covers what is going on underneath, what to ask your doctor to test, and the honest write-ups of the options that are not us.

The member library is the same subject matter taken considerably further. Not a different opinion — a much longer, more detailed treatment of it, for someone who has decided to do this properly and wants the whole picture rather than the introduction.

gate.title: What the member library covers
paragraphs: **The full briefing.** A long-form guide to getting the most out of the six months: protein, blood sugar, vitamin D and sleep, each explained properly — what the evidence actually shows, how much difference it plausibly makes, and what to do about it. Not a leaflet of tips. The version with the reasoning left in.

**Reading your own results.** A detailed walk through the blood tests that matter for hair — ferritin, thyroid, vitamin D, androgens — what the numbers mean, why 'normal' is a wide range, and how to have a more useful conversation with your doctor.
**The whole ingredient story.** For each of the twenty ingredients, the longer version: the trials in full, their limitations, what is still unknown, and why we landed on the dose we did.
**Tracking that keeps you honest.** Monthly photo prompts and a private place to keep them, so at month six you can see what actually changed instead of trying to remember.
**The community.** Other women in the middle of the same thing, at different stages of it. People who do not need it explained to them, and who will not tell you it is normal.

sections.heading: As easy as joining. We mean it literally.
paragraphs: Two clicks in your account, any time after the first three deliveries. No phone call, no form, no retention script, no offer between you and the button.
We have written a whole page about how that works, so you can read it before you ever give us a card rather than discovering it afterwards.
